vision_backend.title: Vision backend
vision_backend.description: Which model 'sees' the screen and picks actions: 'local' uses an Ollama vision model (private, offline, slower on CPU); 'cloud' uses the configured cloud vision API (faster, more precise at clicking).

vision_model.title: Local vision model
vision_model.description: Ollama tag of a vision-capable model used when vision_backend=local (e.g. qwen2.5vl:7b, llama3.2-vision:11b). Must already be pulled in Ollama.

cloud_endpoint.title: Cloud vision endpoint
cloud_endpoint.description: Anthropic Messages API endpoint used when vision_backend=cloud.

cloud_model.title: Cloud vision model
cloud_model.description: Model id sent to the cloud vision endpoint (your provider's current vision model).

cloud_api_key.title: Cloud vision API key
cloud_api_key.description: API key for the cloud vision endpoint. Required only when vision_backend=cloud.

app_allowlist.title: Allowed apps
app_allowlist.description: Comma-separated process names the operator may act in, e.g. 'notepad,chrome,explorer'. The foreground window is checked before EVERY action; empty means nothing is allowed (safe default — opt apps in first).

max_steps.title: Max steps per session
max_steps.description: Hard cap on actions before the session stops itself. Keeps a confused loop from running away.

step_delay_ms.title: Delay between actions (ms)
step_delay_ms.description: Visible, interruptible pause after each action so you can watch and Stop in time.
